text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After brilliantly defeating her formidable 
rival Rice Shower at the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), she praised her fellow runners 
and expressed her resolve to do her best 
in the next race too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target race is the "Takarazuka 
Kinen." Heading out for self-training the 
following morning, she catches sight of 
Mejiro McQueen putting in the laps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run so stoically to channel her 
regret from the Tenno Sho (Spring) into 
the Takarazuka Kinen, Machikane Tannhauser 
is deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The GⅠ medium-distance Takarazuka Kinen is 
in two months. To seize victory, I need to 
give training everything I've got!
